Hi all — quick technical note from SE:

- Adding 8x A100 (40GB) to a 32-GPU pool to get to 40 GPUs is straightforward. For 512-token requests we estimate sustained throughput to increase roughly proportionally to GPU count; expect ~1.25x the existing tokens/sec if the workload scales linearly.
- For a 40-GPU pool serving mixed-length requests, we recommend enabling continuous batching + prefix KV caching for your hot endpoints; this reduces per-token cost and preserves p95 latency.
- Latency: with current model config (lm-medium-24b), p95 at 512 tokens should be around 320–400ms across the pool at target load; we'll size autoscaling headroom to keep p95 < 500ms.

If OptiGrid needs contractual latency guarantees, we'll need to prescribe an explicit throughput target and a minimum reserved headroom (we typically recommend 10–15% buffer). Happy to run a short benchmark with a sample prompt set.

— Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
